parameters.query: SELECT documentType::text AS "documentType", documentId AS "documentId", firstName AS "firstName", secondName AS "secondName", lastNames AS "lastNames", birthdate::text AS "birthdate", genre::text AS "genre" FROM person ORDER BY documentId;

parameters.jsCode: const d=$json; const months=['ene','feb','mar','abr','may','jun','jul','ago','sep','oct','nov','dic']; const b=new Date(`${d.birthdate}T00:00:00Z`); const now=new Date(); let age=now.getUTCFullYear()-b.getUTCFullYear(); if (now.getUTCMonth()<b.getUTCMonth() || (now.getUTCMonth()===b.getUTCMonth() && now.getUTCDate()<b.getUTCDate())) age--; const date=`${String(b.getUTCDate()).padStart(2,'0')}-${months[b.getUTCMonth()]}-${b.getUTCFullYear()}`; const names=[d.firstName,d.secondName,d.lastNames].filter(Boolean).join(' '); const genres={MASCULINO:'Masculino',FEMENINO:'Femenino',NO_BINARIO:'No binario',PREFIERO_NO_REPORTAR:'Prefiero no reportar'}; const content=`Persona: ${names}. Documento: ${d.documentType} ${d.documentId}.\nFecha de nacimiento: ${date} (${age} años). Género: ${genres[d.genre]||d.genre}.`; return [{json:{...d,content}}];

parameters.query: WITH removed AS (DELETE FROM vector_person WHERE metadata->>'documentId' = $1 RETURNING 1) INSERT INTO vector_person(content,embedding,metadata) VALUES ($2,$3::vector,jsonb_build_object('documentId',$1,'numero_documento',$1,'documentType',$4));
